directFinding: The actual Volcengine endpoint returned HTTP403 AccountOverdueError. This is a provider-account billing interruption, not evidence of model task ability or a CLI/IDE execution failure. No automatic retry was performed.
recoveryAuthorization: User instructed continuation on 2026-11-03 after identifying the likely overdue balance; keep prior successes and replay interrupted samples separately.
limitations: The error body does not include token usage or an account billing receipt. Unknown cost stays null, never zero.
Later successful requests are required to demonstrate billing admission has recovered; catalog authentication alone does not prove account balance.
